_why: System settings must report observed permission states instead of constants. Every check is passive: it belongs to the Electron main process, launches no target, and requests no consent. The request entry points are separate and run only from the settings page's explicit grant button.

request._why: Completing a request does not prove consent. A failed request must provide feedback instead of silently leaving the same grant button.
request.denied: refresh the observed state and open the corresponding System Settings pane
request.unknown: refresh the observed state and show an authorization request failure
request.pending: disable permission actions and label the active grant button as requesting authorization

automation.descriptor: running-process PID (a bundle-id descriptor measured procNotFound even while the target ran)
automation.launchTarget: only after the passive query reports the target absent (procNotFound); System Events is a faceless system agent, and Apple's query resolves the target to a running process, so the recorded decision is unobservable otherwise

location.source: CLLocationManager authorizationStatus plus locationServicesEnabled, passive read

notification.source: UNUserNotificationCenter getNotificationSettings, passive read in the main process
